items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_lock.de: Solidify the earth where the caster desires.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_manipul: Boosts the power of Earth abilities by a decent amount.
Raises earth spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_storm.d: Summons a viscous sandstorm and falling rocks around you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_transfo: Channel the powers of the earth to deal increased damage and increase local gravity around you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_wall.de: Call forth giant earth walls from the ground.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earthshatter_: Stomp your foot down upheaving the land around you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.eight_petals_: Dash and attack the target's eyes, throat, heart, kidneys, lungs, and groin with eight consecutive and near instant slashes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.electricity_r: Ignore weak electrical damage or resist the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.electro_blast: Fire a beam attack that pierces through enemies and deals devastating damage while paralyzing your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.elephant_stam: Throw a ring of aura spheres around you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.engorger.desc: Increase your size and boost your physical stats.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.envy.descript: Absorb strength from enemies, buff yourself and debilitate your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.escape.descri: Connect two points in space to create a escape route.

By obtaining the mythical Hero Egg, the veil of deception is torn apart. No illusion or concealment can deceive your sight, and your vision becomes perfect.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.falsifier.des: See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes and create illusions.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire.descript: Use your spirit to start a small fire.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_breath.d: Breathe flames and incinerate your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_storm.de: Call forth fiery surges of flame to incinerate targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_wall.des: Create a wall of fire to keep targets away.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.five_petals_t: Dash and pierce the opponent in five of ten vital points and uses the other five as feints.
